### Fixed
- **`muster auth login` reports why it cannot reach the server instead of a missing challenge.** Against a server whose TLS certificate the host does not trust, or one that refuses the connection, the sign-in failed with `no auth challenge available`, hiding the x509 or connection error. The discovery probe now keeps the error of a request that got no response, and the login and `--force` re-login report it (`cannot reach <endpoint>: … x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`). A server that answers without a challenge still reports `no auth challenge available`. ([#1527](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/issues/1527))
